clue.text: Perhaps does bring in police for important game

indicators.note: to bring in is to take something inside, so the police letters go inside the animals

parts.note: does are female deer, so 'perhaps' marks them as an example of deer
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the UK detective branch

explanation.surface: A detective drama: someone fetches the police ahead of a big match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'does' looks like a verb but is the plural of doe, a female deer.
explanation.definitionFit: A decisive final match or tie-breaking game is called a decider, so it is the one that matters most.

clue.text: Tax obligation

definitions.meaning: a levy charged on goods, such as customs or excise
something one is morally or legally bound to do

explanation.surface: A two-word phrase about money owed to the state.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a levy on imports and a moral responsibility go by this one word, two separate senses.

clue.text: Company covering most of continent that's noted for electronic devices

indicators.note: one piece covers another by wrapping round it, so the company letters sit outside
most of a word means it loses its final letter

parts.note: Asia is the largest continent

explanation.surface: A firm with a huge market across a continent, famous for its gadgets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's' links; the definition is a description of the firm, best known for calculators and digital watches.
explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese manufacturer is famous for calculators, keyboards and digital watches, all electronic devices.

clue.text: Not applicable to return after Cummings gets single from Blackfriars

indicators.note: one piece comes after another, so the abbreviation follows the name

parts.note: Dominic Cummings was a political adviser to Boris Johnson

indicators.note: returning means the abbreviation is read backwards

explanation.surface: A political aside about Cummings getting a single item from a London district.
explanation.walkthrough: Blackfriars, in London, is named after the black-robed friars of the Dominican order; 'single' means one of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A friar of the Order of Preachers, whose black habits gave Blackfriars its name, is one member of that order.

clue.text: After resistance, French joiner Claude learns new skills

indicators.note: the other pieces follow the resistance letter in order

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance
et is French for 'and', a joining word
Claude Rains was an English-born film actor (Casablanca)

explanation.surface: A French carpenter named Claude acquires a new trade after some opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joiner' suggests a carpenter, but it is a conjunction joining words.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrain is to be taught fresh abilities, typically for a new job.

clue.text: Play, with these for goalposts?

parts.note: children's street football marks the goals with discarded pullovers, a nostalgic British phrase

explanation.surface: An invitation to an informal kickabout with makeshift goals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumpers for goalposts' is a British phrase recalling park football, where sweaters (jumpers) were piled up to mark the goal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweaters thrown on the grass serve as goal markers in a casual kickabout.

clue.text: Muslim extremist I had put in jail regularly

indicators.note: the two words are placed inside the letters picked from the jail
regularly means every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A militant is sent to prison, perhaps by the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A fighter in a holy war, especially a militant Islamist, is the noun for such an extremist.

clue.text: Good-hearted mother into soft rock

indicators.note: having a heart of something means it sits in the middle, so the letter goes in the centre

parts.note: mama is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A kind mother gets into gentle rock music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft rock' suggests a music genre; here it is molten rock under the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Molten rock beneath the earth's crust is soft rather than solid stone.

clue.text: Say Elton's satellite connection to America is very bad

parts.note: EG (for example) is introduced by 'say'
Elton John's birth name is Reginald Dwight, hence Reg
Io is a moon of Jupiter
US is the United States

explanation.surface: A satellite link to the US for Elton's broadcast turns out dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: Something outstandingly shocking, an awful mistake or behaviour, is described with this adjective.

clue.text: Stop section of sportsground getting quiet

parts.note: a stand is a tiered seating area at a stadium
still means calm and silent

explanation.surface: A part of the stadium falls silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A halt in which all movement has ceased is a noun for a stop.

clue.text: Try partnership for international contest

parts.note: to try something is to test it
a match is a pairing, as in a marriage

explanation.surface: A trial pairing ahead of a game between countries.
explanation.walkthrough: A test match is an international game of cricket or rugby.
explanation.definitionFit: A game between national sides in cricket or rugby goes by this name.

clue.text: Irish police infiltrating group of sugar daddies

indicators.note: the police get inside the run of words, so the letters lie within them

explanation.surface: Irish detectives go undercover among wealthy older men.
explanation.definitionFit: The Garda Síochána is the national police force of the Republic of Ireland.

clue.text: Gundog bandaged up, trussed and kept quiet

indicators.note: up here means mixed up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An injured hunting dog is wrapped in bandages and muzzled.
explanation.definitionFit: Tied up and with a cloth over the mouth describes someone restrained and silenced.

clue.text: Certain clothing to remove in trees

indicators.note: one piece sits in another, so the removal word goes inside the trees

parts.note: pines are evergreen conifers
to strip is to remove, especially clothing

explanation.surface: Someone takes off clothes among the trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A suit with fine vertical lines, a banker's classic outfit, is a specific kind of clothing.

clue.text: Excited Poles acted in porn movie

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up, so they are reshuffled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Thrilled Polish actors appear in an adult film.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1993 Hollywood film starring Robert Redford and Demi Moore bears this title.

clue.text: Some blue material from jeans initially caught in frame under muck

indicators.note: in a down answer the second part sits below the first

parts.note: dirt is muck or filth

indicators.note: a letter caught in a frame is held inside it

parts.note: a yoke is a wooden frame joining oxen

indicators.note: initially means the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: A pair of jeans caught on a frame gets dirty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blue material' suggests denim fabric; blue here means risqué.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue humour is smutty, so a vulgar gag is a piece of risqué material.

clue.text: Caper with terrible actor outside Venice opening

indicators.note: the reworked actor goes around the letter
a terrible performance is a mess, so the letters are reordered
the opening of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A dreadful performer clowns around outside a Venetian première.
explanation.definitionFit: To caper is to leap or prance playfully, which is a synonym for this verb.

clue.text: Dismay Sooty's girlfriend getting up on a horse

parts.note: to appal is to dismay

indicators.note: in a down answer, getting up means the letters read upwards

parts.note: Soo is the panda girlfriend of Sooty, the British children's TV glove puppet bear

explanation.surface: A children's puppet's girlfriend climbs on a horse, to everyone's dismay.
explanation.walkthrough: Sooty is a British TV glove puppet; Soo is his panda friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotted American breed of riding horse goes by this name.

clue.text: It's not refined, but it could be slick

definitions.text: It's not refined, but it could be slick

parts.words: It's not refined, but it could be slick
parts.note: unrefined petroleum is crude, and a spill of it at sea forms a slick, though slick also means smooth and sophisticated

explanation.surface: A puzzling remark about something unsophisticated that might still be smooth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refined' and 'slick' look like opposites about manners; both are about petroleum.
explanation.definitionFit: Unprocessed petroleum has not been through a refinery, and a spill forms an oil slick.

clue.text: Jump season

definitions.meaning: the time of year between winter and summer

explanation.surface: A two-word note about a leap and a time of year.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sudden leap and the season after winter.

clue.text: See 13
Spoil dissertation about Malta

indicators.note: one piece goes about another, so the dissertation surrounds the letter

parts.note: a paper is an academic essay
M is the international vehicle registration code for Malta

explanation.surface: A thesis on Malta is ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: To indulge someone with excessive comfort, as with a spoilt child, is to cosset them.

clue.text: Had Butler's hymn rewritten in the style of the early Stones

definitions.text: the style of the early Stones

indicators.note: a rewritten text has its letters rearranged into something new

explanation.surface: A butler's hymn is rearranged in the manner of the 1960s Rolling Stones.
explanation.definitionFit: The early Rolling Stones played cover versions of American black popular music of that genre.

clue.text: Uninteresting house smell

parts.note: hum is British slang for a bad smell

explanation.surface: A dull home with an odour.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation expresses boredom, and as an adjective means dull or ordinary.

clue.text: Spanish hero cut up about rival finally heading north

indicators.note: in a down answer, heading north means read upwards
the chopped piece goes about the letter

parts.note: to dice is to cut into small cubes

indicators.note: finally means the last letter is taken

explanation.surface: A Spanish champion, wounded, goes after his opponent on his way north.
explanation.walkthrough: DICE around L gives DICLE, which 'heading north' turns upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar, the medieval Castilian warrior, is known by this nickname.

clue.text: Catch someone involved in electronic surveillance?

definitions.meaning: to catch sight of something, to spot it
read as ..., an agent who snoops electronically, with E for electronic

explanation.surface: A question about catching a hacker who spies online.
explanation.definitionFit: Spotting something at a distance, catching sight of it, is a literary verb for seeing.

clue.text: Dog mess on chain

parts.note: poo is dog mess, excrement
CH is the abbreviation for chain, an old unit of length

explanation.surface: A dog fouls the pavement while on its lead.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal or affectionate word for a pet hound.

clue.text: In favour of senior manager keeping junior manager in trunk

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: keeping means holding inside, so the boss surrounds the junior

parts.note: a boss is a senior manager
CI is Chief Inspector, a lower management rank in the UK police

explanation.surface: A senior executive backing a junior one in a corporate hierarchy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trunk' suggests luggage or a tree; it is an elephant's nose.
explanation.definitionFit: An elephant's long flexible nose is its trunk, and this is the zoological word for it.

clue.text: Pan side in series

indicators.note: the side goes in the series abbreviation

parts.note: a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: A critic slates a team mid-series.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pan' looks like a verb, to criticise; it is a cooking vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A perforated pan used to cook food over boiling water is a kitchen vessel of this kind.

clue.text: Played a trick — it doesn't occur very often

indicators.note: a trick played on letters jumbles them into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone pulled a prank, a rare event.
explanation.definitionFit: The 29th of February appears only once every four years, so it is a rare date.
